_readme: Website content, kept apart from layout (src/v3.py). status: draft = review preview only; proposed = shown in the release candidate, awaiting Purav's approval; published = live. availability (public label): available | service | pilot. Prices: only approved figures; anything disputed is a scoped quote. Research may propose changes here; it never edits this file on its own. slug: page path under the site root; existing live URLs are reused where one exists. demos: publication status of demo pages that aren't always on (draft = review preview only). cta: optional button wording.

pilot.title: Subscribe to a repeatable solution
pilot.summary: Tools built from repeat project work, run for you with clear usage and support limits. None is on sale yet. Tell us the job you would want handled, and you will hear if a pilot opens.
pilot.msg: Subscription pilot interest. The job I'd want handled:

services.title: Cash & data check
services.summary: Your bills, invoices and timesheets checked against each other, with every finding traced to its record.
services.buyer: Owners and finance leads of businesses that bill time or fixed fees.
services.problem: Bills, timesheets and invoices sit in different systems, so nobody can say which hours never reached an invoice or which bills don't match the job.
deliverables: Bills, invoices and timesheets joined from your exports
A findings register: each item confirmed, needing information or explained, with the record behind it
A short read-out of what to look at first
boundaries: Works from exports, with no logins to your ledger
Reports what the records support; some findings need your explanation before action
No tax or BAS advice

services.title: Cash & job profit model
services.summary: A 13-week cash view and profit by job or client, tied back to the ledger.
services.buyer: Businesses that need to see cash and job margins ahead, not after month-end.
services.problem: The bank balance and last month's profit and loss don't show which week cash gets tight or which jobs make money.
deliverables: A 13-week cash forecast that refreshes from your weekly exports
Profit by job or client, reconciled to the ledger
Written assumptions and a handover session
boundaries: A model and its assumptions, not financial product advice
You run it after handover; ongoing review only where agreed in writing

services.title: Data engineering
services.summary: Xero, your CRM, job app and spreadsheets connected into one clean source.
services.buyer: Teams whose numbers live across several systems and spreadsheets.
services.problem: Every report starts with copy and paste, and the same figure means different things in different systems.
deliverables: A map of systems, owners and where the numbers disagree
A plain-English data dictionary
Scheduled pipelines with checks that flag missing or odd records
One clean source for reports, models and AI tools
boundaries: Built in your own accounts; you keep the code and documentation
Source records are never changed

services.title: Dashboards & management reporting
services.summary: A reporting pack or dashboard on agreed definitions, reconciled to the ledger.
services.buyer: Owners, boards and finance leads who want one view they can trust.
services.problem: Reports arrive late, disagree with each other or answer last month's question.
deliverables: A dashboard or report pack on agreed definitions
Reconciliation back to the ledger
Notes on what each measure means and where it comes from
boundaries: Built in tools you already use, such as Excel or Power BI, where practical
Commentary and decisions stay with your team

services.title: Workflow review & redesign
services.summary: One process mapped end to end, with the handoffs, re-keying and waiting taken out before anything is automated.
services.buyer: Small businesses, startups and solo operators whose admin keeps growing with the work.
services.problem: The same information is typed into several places, jobs wait on one person, and nobody can see where time goes.
deliverables: A map of the current process and where time and errors build up
A redesigned process with named owners and approval points
A short list of what to automate, what to simplify and what to leave alone
boundaries: Recommendations and design; building them is scoped separately
Your people decide what changes
services.msg: Workflow review: the process I'd like to fix is

services.title: Workflow automation
services.summary: One repetitive finance or admin workflow automated, tested and handed over.
services.buyer: Teams doing the same matching, chasing and checking every week.
services.problem: Routine steps take hours and errors surface late.
deliverables: One workflow mapped, built and tested on your past records
Approval steps and limits for anything touching money or customers
A log of what ran and what was held for a person
A runbook and handover
boundaries: Nothing is paid or sent without a person
No payments initiated from your bank accounts by software

services.title: AI workflows & integration
services.summary: AI built into one defined piece of work, tested before it goes live, with a person approving the output.
services.buyer: Businesses ready to put AI into a defined piece of real work.
services.problem: People are already trying AI tools, but nobody has set the limits, the tests or who signs off.
deliverables: A written job description and limits for the AI step
Tests on your past records against a pass mark agreed in writing
A trial run alongside your team before going live
A decision log in your own accounts, a spending cap and an off switch
boundaries: AI never signs anything off; a named person does
Independent tool advice: no software resold

services.title: Chatbots & AI assistants
services.summary: Help customers find answers, capture better enquiries and give your team easier access to approved business information, with clear limits and a hand-over to a person.
services.buyer: Small businesses and startups answering the same questions by email, phone and chat, or whose team keeps searching for the same internal information.
services.problem: Generic chat widgets guess when they don't know, can be talked into ignoring their rules, and leave staff to untangle half-captured enquiries.
deliverables: One assistant for one defined task: a customer enquiry assistant, an internal knowledge assistant, or a workflow assistant that prepares actions for approval
An approved knowledge pack, with every answer linked to its source
Tested against real questions, including ones it should refuse, and attempts to override its instructions
A clear hand-over to a person, with an enquiry summary they can act on
A usage and cost cap, logging you control, and a written runbook
boundaries: Answers only from information you approve; says so when it doesn't know
Doesn't send messages, book jobs, take payments or change records without a person approving
No financial, legal or tax advice to your customers
Model, hosting and data-retention choices agreed with you before anything goes live

services.title: Compliance controls sprint
services.summary: One obligation mapped: AI use, AML/CTF Tranche 2 or the Privacy Act automated-decision rules.
services.buyer: Businesses facing one specific obligation now.
services.problem: It is unclear what is in scope, who owns it and where a person must approve.
deliverables: A register of what is in scope
Named owners, rules and approval points
A 90-day plan and the first workflow worth running under controls
boundaries: General information and controls design, not legal advice; legal interpretation stays with your adviser
No ledger access needed

services.title: AI governance for boards & owners
services.summary: A register, policy and reporting line for the AI already in use.
services.buyer: Boards, directors and owners who need to oversee AI use.
services.problem: AI is already inside staff habits and software, with no register, policy or board reporting.
deliverables: An AI register and automated-decision map
An AI use policy and control set
A board reporting format
boundaries: Not legal advice
Running the controls each month is a separate, scoped arrangement

services.title: Defined change workstream
services.summary: For larger organisations: one scoped workstream, from process and stakeholder mapping to tested controls and adoption.
services.buyer: Project sponsors in larger organisations with a defined finance, data or AI change.
services.problem: The change touches several teams and systems, and nobody owns how the process, data and controls fit together.
deliverables: Scope, stakeholders and a current-process map
System integration plan and test approach
Controls tested before go-live, and adoption support afterwards
boundaries: One defined workstream, alongside your project lead and teams
Beiz is a small practice and agrees capacity up front

services.title: Workshops for owners & teams
services.summary: Small-group or in-house sessions on putting AI and data to work safely in day-to-day finance and admin.
services.buyer: Owners, finance leads and small teams.
services.problem: People want to use AI at work but don't know where to start, or what limits to set.
deliverables: A small-group online session or an in-house workshop
A live walk-through on made-up data
A written plan for the first job worth automating
boundaries: General information, not financial or legal advice

services.title: Coaching for finance professionals
services.summary: One-to-one sessions for accountants and finance leads who want to build working data and AI skills.
services.problem: Courses and articles don't turn into a working model or automation in your own job.
deliverables: An agreed learning goal tied to a real piece of work
Hands-on sessions building a model, report or automation on synthetic or approved data
Your build reviewed, explained and documented
boundaries: Skills coaching, not career, financial or legal advice
No employer or client confidential data used in sessions

services.title: Speaking & panels
services.summary: Talks and panel sessions on practical AI, data and controls in finance and small business.
services.buyer: Event organisers, professional bodies and boards.
services.problem: Audiences hear a lot about AI and little about what it takes to make it work safely in a real business.
deliverables: Topics such as: what changes when AI enters the finance workflow; testing and approval points before go-live; getting data in shape before automating
Tailored to the audience, with worked examples on synthetic data
boundaries: General information, not advice
